line.zh: HSK 3.0 背词与声调训练 · 界面：英语、한국어、ไทย

lead.en: Learn the words of the new HSK 3.0 exam and finally hear the tones.
lead.zh: 给海外中文学习者的 App：按 2025 年 11 月发布的 HSK 3.0 官方大纲背词，再用七天声调营把四个声调听清楚。

t.en: See each tone as a pitch curve, then draw the pitch you hear.
t.zh: 看音高曲线、听，再用手指画出听到的声调。

t.en: Always free, never capped.
t.zh: 快忘的时候再复习一次，复习永远免费、不限量。

t.en: Strokes, radicals and components for each character.
t.zh: 笔画、部首、部件，联想记忆注明「不是字源」。

alt.en: Tone Camp, day 1: the four tones as pitch curves
alt.zh: 声调营第一天：四个声调的音高曲线

alt.en: Character card for 爱 with its components

note.en: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play
note.zh: 即将登陆 App Store 与 Google Play

title.en: Kaihua 开花 · HSK 3.0 vocab & tones
title.zh: 开花 Kaihua · HSK 3.0 背词与声调训练

description.en: Kaihua helps you learn the words of the new HSK 3.0 exam and hear the tones: a 7-Day Tone Camp, FSRS reviews that are always free, and explanations in English, Korean and Thai.
description.zh: 开花 Kaihua：按 HSK 3.0 官方大纲背词，七天声调营练耳朵，FSRS 复习永远免费，讲解有英语、韩语、泰语三种。

h1.en: Learn the HSK 3.0 words. Hear the tones.
h1.zh:
背 HSK 3.0 的词，
听清四个声调。

lead.en: Short daily sessions built on the new HSK 3.0 word lists, a 7-day camp that trains your ear for tones, and explanations written for your language.
lead.zh: 每天一小段，词表来自新版 HSK 3.0 官方大纲；七天声调营专练耳朵；讲解按学习者的母语来写。

t.en: words, HSK 3.0 levels 1–6
t.zh: 个词，HSK 3.0 一至六级

t.en: of Tone Camp, free
t.zh: 声调营，免费

t.en: interface languages
t.zh: 种界面语言

alt.en: Tone Camp, day 1: meet the four tones
alt.zh: 声调营第一天：认识四个声调

alt.en: A word card for 爱 ài after answering

caption.en: Same syllable, four tones, four different words. Kaihua trains your ear first.
caption.zh: 同一个音节，四个声调，就是四个不同的词。开花先练耳朵。

caption.en: No speech scoring: it is often wrong, so tone practice is about listening.
caption.zh: 不做发音打分：机器打分常常不准，声调练习以听为主。

h2.zh:
开花里有什么，
直接看界面。

side.en: Every screen on this page is the app itself, with the word list that ships in it.
side.zh: 本页的截图都是 App 真实界面，里面的词都来自 App 自带的词库。

h3.en: Seven days to hear the four tones.
h3.zh: 七天，把四个声调听清楚。

p.en: See each tone as a pitch curve, hear it, then draw the pitch you heard with your finger.
p.zh: 先看每个声调的音高曲线，再听，然后用手指画出听到的音高。

list.en: Minimal pairs and all 20 two-syllable tone combinations
list.zh: 最小对立对，以及全部 20 种双音节声调组合

list.en: Tone changes for third tones, 一 yī and 不 bù
A graduation test at the end, then a short daily warm-up
list.zh: 最后一天结业测试，之后每天有简短热身

alt.en: Tone Camp: pitch curves for the four tones
alt.zh: 声调营：四个声调的音高曲线

h3.en: Answer first, then see the card.

p.en: Kaihua grades you from your answer and how fast you gave it. Tap “Too easy” when a word is already yours.
p.zh: 开花根据你答得对不对、用了多久自动评分；已经会的词，点一下「Too easy」就行。

list.en: Collocations and two example sentences with audio
list.zh: 常用搭配，两个带录音的例句

list.en: Each word compared with the old HSK 2.0 list: new, moved to another level, or the same
list.zh: 每个词都和旧版 HSK 2.0 词表对照：新增、调级或不变

list.en: Pinyin fades as you master a word
list.zh: 越熟的词，拼音显示得越淡

alt.en: Word card for 爱 with collocations and examples

h3.en: Look up anything, even without tones.

p.en: Search words, characters and grammar points by characters, by pinyin with or without tone marks, or by meaning.
p.zh: 词、字、语法点都能搜：输入汉字、带调或不带调的拼音、或者意思都行。

list.en: Same sound, different tones: 买 mǎi and 卖 mài side by side
list.zh: 同音不同调的词并排对比，比如 买 mǎi 和 卖 mài

list.en: Words beyond your level show their HSK level
list.zh: 超出当前级别的词会标出它的 HSK 级别

alt.en: Search for mai: 买 mǎi and 卖 mài side by side
alt.zh: 搜索 mai：买 mǎi 与 卖 mài 并排

p.en: Strokes, radical and components for each character: 爱 = 爫 + 冖 + 友. Memory hooks are labeled “mnemonic, not etymology”.
p.zh: 每个字都有笔画、部首和部件，比如 爱 = 爫 + 冖 + 友。联想记忆会注明「只是助记，不是字源」。

h3.en: Practice in the exam's own formats.

p.en: Short grammar quizzes with explanations, and mock tests that follow the official HSK question types (Pro).
p.zh: 带讲解的语法小测，以及按 HSK 官方题型出的模拟测验（Pro）。

alt.en: Mock test: reading part 2, fill in the blank
alt.zh: 模拟测验：阅读第二部分，选词填空

h2.zh:
在快要忘的时候，
再复习一次。

lead.en: Reviews are planned by FSRS, an open-source memory model, and fit the study time you choose each day. Every word is a plant in your Memory Garden: review on time and it blooms, wait too long and it wilts.
lead.zh: 复习时间由开源记忆模型 FSRS 安排，并按你每天定下的学习时长调整分量。每个词是记忆花园里的一株花：按时复习就开花，拖得太久就会蔫。

t.en: reviews, always
t.zh: 复习永远免费

t.en: on how many
t.zh: 想复习多少都行

t.en: reminder at your usual time
t.zh: 在你常学的时间提醒

h2.en: Start free. Stay free if you like.
h2.zh:
免费开始，
一直免费用也可以。

side.en: Prices are shown in the app and vary by region.
side.zh: 价格以 App 内显示为准，各地区不同。

items.en: 10 new words a day from HSK 2
items.zh: 二级起每天 10 个新词

fine.en: Ads are limited to an optional short video (for extra words or to repair a streak) and one ad on the session-complete screen. Never while you study. Some regions also offer a one-time Remove Ads purchase.
fine.zh: 广告只有两处：你自己选择观看的短视频（换额外新词或补签），以及学习结束页上的一条广告。学习过程中不出现广告。部分地区另有一次性的「去广告」购买。

items.en: Unlimited new words and characters at every level
items.zh: 各级别新词、新字不限量

items.en: Exam pacing, mock tests and grammar for levels 2–3
items.zh: 按考试日期排进度、模拟测验、二三级语法

items.en: A second voice, and no ads
items.zh: 多一个男声发音，没有广告

fine.en: Subscriptions are managed in your App Store or Google Play account. The lifetime purchase never renews.
fine.zh: 订阅在 App Store 或 Google Play 账户里管理；终身买断不会自动续费。

t.en: Open the app and start. Nothing to sign up for.
t.zh: 打开就能学，没有账号要注册。

t.en: Your progress is stored on your phone, not on our servers.
t.zh: 学习进度保存在你的手机里，不在我们的服务器上。

t.en: All words, and audio for levels 1–4, ship inside the app.
t.zh: 全部词条和一至四级的音频都装在 App 里。

q.zh: 开花用的是哪一版 HSK？

a.en: HSK 3.0, the syllabus published in November 2025. Kaihua covers levels 1–6: all 5,400 words and 1,940 characters, plus 244 grammar points for levels 1–3. Audio for levels 5–6 is coming in an update. Every word is tagged against HSK 2.0, so you can see what is new and what moved.
a.zh: HSK 3.0，即 2025 年 11 月发布的新大纲。开花覆盖一至六级：全部 5,400 个词、1,940 个字，另有一至三级的 244 个语法点；五、六级的音频会在后续更新里补上。每个词都标出和 HSK 2.0 的差别，哪些是新增的、哪些调了级，一看就知道。

q.zh: 开花会给我的发音打分吗？

a.en: No. Tone training is listening-first: you hear, compare and draw the pitch. Speech scoring is often wrong, so we left it out.
a.zh: 不会。声调训练以听为主：听、比较，再画出音高。机器给发音打分经常出错，所以我们没有做。

a.en: The Tone Camp, all of HSK 1 and every review are free. Pro adds unlimited new words, grammar for levels 2–3, exam prep with mock tests, memory curves, a second voice and no ads. In some regions a one-time Remove Ads purchase is also offered; it removes ads only.
a.zh: 声调营、HSK 一级全部内容和所有复习都免费。Pro 增加不限量的新词、二三级语法、备考进度和模拟测验、记忆曲线、第二个发音，并去掉广告。部分地区另有一次性的「去广告」购买，只去掉广告。

a.en: No. Progress is stored on your phone and the app works offline.
a.zh: 不需要。进度存在手机上，离线也能用。

q.en: Will my progress move to a new phone?

a.en: Not yet. There is no cloud sync at the moment. A Pro purchase can be restored on a new phone with Restore purchases.
a.zh: 目前不会。现在还没有云同步。已购买的 Pro 可以在新手机上用「Restore purchases」（恢复购买）找回。

q.en: Where does the word list come from?

a.en: From the official HSK 3.0 syllabus, word for word. Pinyin and parts of speech are checked against the syllabus and a reference dictionary. How meanings, examples and audio are made and checked is explained in section 7 of the Privacy Policy.
a.zh: 词表逐词取自 HSK 3.0 官方大纲，拼音和词性都对照大纲和参考词典核对过。释义、例句和音频是怎么制作、怎么核对的，见隐私政策第 7 节。

t.en: Restore purchases, cancel Pro, delete your data
t.zh: 恢复购买、取消 Pro、删除数据

t.en: What stays on your device, and what does not
t.zh: 哪些数据留在手机上，哪些不是

t.en: Subscriptions, lifetime purchase, refunds
t.zh: 订阅、终身买断、退款

mail.en: Still stuck? Write to {email} with your device model and app version.
mail.zh: 还有问题？写信到 {email}，附上手机型号和 App 版本。

langs.en: The Privacy Policy is also available in

p.en: Kaihua is coming soon to iPhone and Android, in English, Korean and Thai.
p.zh: 开花即将上线 iPhone 和安卓，界面有英语、韩语、泰语三种。

trademark.en: HSK is a registered trademark of the Center for Language Education and Cooperation (CLEC). Kaihua is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CLEC or Chinese Testing International.
trademark.zh: HSK 是中外语言交流合作中心（CLEC）的注册商标。开花是独立开发的 App，与 CLEC、汉考国际无关，也未获其认可。

title.th: นโยบายความเป็นส่วนตัว

description.en: How the Kaihua app handles your information: no account, progress stored on your device, purchases via RevenueCat and ads via Google AdMob.
description.zh: 开花 Kaihua 如何处理你的信息：无需账号，进度存在本机，购买经 RevenueCat，广告来自 Google AdMob。
description.ko: Kaihua 앱의 개인정보 처리 방침: 계정 없음, 학습 기록은 기기에만 저장, RevenueCat을 통한 구매, Google AdMob 광고.
description.th: นโยบายความเป็นส่วนตัวของแอป Kaihua: ไม่ต้องมีบัญชี ความคืบหน้าเก็บในเครื่อง การซื้อผ่าน RevenueCat และโฆษณาจาก Google AdMob

description.en: Terms of Use for the Kaihua app: free features, Kaihua Pro subscriptions and lifetime purchase, refunds and learning content.
description.zh: 开花 Kaihua 使用条款：免费功能、Pro 订阅与终身买断、退款与学习内容。

description.en: Kaihua support: restore purchases, cancel a subscription, refunds, moving to a new phone, deleting your data and contacting us.
description.zh: 开花 Kaihua 支持：恢复购买、取消订阅、退款、换手机、删除数据和联系我们。

line.en: Android · iPhone & iPad · HarmonyOS, in testing
line.zh: 安卓 · iPhone 与 iPad · 鸿蒙，测试中

lead.en: A free practice log for daily recitation, meditation and reading: a counter with bead mode, check-in calendar, meditation timer with bells, and a library for your own files.
lead.zh: 免费、公益的功课记录工具：计数（念珠模式每圈 108）、打卡日历、禅修计时与钟声、个人资料库。

quiet_note.en: Nothing pops up while you count or sit.
quiet_note.zh: 计数和静坐的时候，不会弹出任何窗口。

title.en: ChiHeng 持恒 · a quiet practice log
title.zh: 持恒 · 功课记录、计数与禅修计时

description.en: ChiHeng is a free practice log for daily recitation, meditation and reading: counter with bead mode, check-in calendar, meditation timer and your own library. No ads, no login, stored on your device.
description.zh: 持恒是免费、公益的功课记录工具：计数与念珠模式、打卡日历、禅修计时与钟声、个人资料库。无广告、免登录、数据存在本机。

sub.en: chí héng · to keep at it

h1.zh: 每天的功课，安安静静地记下来。

lead.en: Count recitations with a tap, check in on a calendar, sit with a timer and soft bells, and keep the texts and recordings you study in one place. Free, with nothing to sign up for.
lead.zh: 点一下屏幕就是一遍；日历上打卡；静坐时有计时和轻柔的钟声；平时学的经本、录音都放在一处。免费，不用注册。

t.en: no ads, no membership
t.zh: 无广告、无会员

t.en: beads per round, adjustable
t.zh: 念珠每圈默认颗数，可改

t.en: platforms: Android, Apple, HarmonyOS
t.zh: 个平台：安卓、苹果、鸿蒙

alt.en: Counter screen in bead mode (Chinese interface)
alt.zh: 持恒计数界面（念珠模式）

alt.en: Today screen with the day's practices (Chinese interface)

status.en: In testing. Not yet in the app stores.
status.zh: 测试中，尚未在应用商店上架。

h2.zh: 记录每天功课的几样工具。

side.en: Everything revolves around one thing you set up yourself: a practice, such as a daily recitation, a sitting or a reading. Screens shown are the Chinese interface; English is also available.
side.zh: 一切围绕你自己设定的「功课」：每天念多少遍、坐多久、读什么。截图为中文界面，也可切换为英文。

h3.zh: 点屏幕任意处就是一遍。

p.en: The whole screen is the button. Each tap counts one, with a vibration, and a different one when a round is complete.
p.zh: 整个屏幕都是按钮，点一下记一遍，有振动；满一圈换一种振动或提示音。

list.en: Bead mode, 108 per round by default
Count with the volume keys on Android while the counter is open
list.zh: 安卓上打开计数页时，可以用音量键计数

list.en: Undo, a lock against stray taps, and add +N for beads counted offline
list.zh: 可撤销、防误触锁，线下拨珠可补录 +N

p.en: Practices can be counted, timed or simply ticked. Set them for every day, certain weekdays, a number of times a week, or a fixed stretch such as a hundred days.
p.zh: 功课可以计数、计时或打勾；节奏可以是每天、每周固定几天、每周几次，或一段时间（比如百日）。

list.en: Streaks, total days and completion rate at a glance, with no warnings when a streak is about to break
list.zh: 连续天数、累计天数和完成率一眼看清，不会催你「快断签了」

list.en: Make up a missed day, with a small mark on the calendar
list.zh: 漏记可以补卡，日历上会有小标记

h3.en: Sit. The bell will tell you.
h3.zh: 坐下来，时间到了钟声会告诉你。

p.en: Count down, count up, or sit until a set time. Bells with a long, soft tail mark the start, intervals and the end.
p.zh: 倒计时、正计时，或坐到某个时刻为止。开始、间隔、结束都可以设钟声，音色轻柔、余音长。

list.en: Singing bowl, qing, small bell, water drop, chime and a guqin harmonic
list.zh: 颂钵、引磬、铜铃、水滴、柔和钟声、古琴泛音

list.en: Turns on Do Not Disturb while you sit, and turns it off afterwards
list.zh: 静坐时自动开勿扰，结束后关回去

list.en: While you sit, a dim screen shows over the lock screen so the light does not distract you
list.zh: 静坐时锁屏上显示调暗的界面，光线不晃眼

h3.en: See how far you have come.

p.en: Totals by practice for this month, last month, this year or any range, compared with the period before. Long-term goals such as 100,000 recitations show their progress.
p.zh: 按功课看本月、上月、今年或任意时间段的总量，并和上一周期比较；十万遍这样的长期目标也能看到进度。

p.en: ChiHeng ships no content. Add your own PDFs, EPUBs, audio and video, read and listen inside the app, and it remembers where you stopped.
p.zh: 持恒不内置任何内容。你自己导入 PDF、EPUB、音视频，在 App 里读、听，它记得你上次停在哪里。

list.en: PDF, EPUB and TXT open in the built-in reader, with bookmarks, highlights and search
list.zh: PDF、EPUB、TXT 在内置阅读器里打开，可加书签、划线、搜索

list.en: Audio and video play with speed control, a sleep timer and A–B repeat
list.zh: 音视频可调倍速、定时关闭、AB 复读

t.en: Nothing to buy and nothing to watch. It is free.
t.zh: 没有付费点，也没有广告，就是免费。

t.en: Your records are stored on your device.
t.zh: 记录保存在你自己的设备上。

t.en: Export a backup whenever you like and keep it where you choose.
t.zh: 随时导出备份，存到你自己选的地方。

a.en: Yes. There are no ads, no membership and nothing to buy.
a.zh: 是的。没有广告，没有会员，也没有任何付费项目。

q.en: Is it only for Buddhist practice?
q.zh: 只能用来记佛教功课吗？

a.en: No. It was made with Buddhist practitioners in mind, but the wording is neutral and a practice can be anything you repeat: recitation, sitting, reading, exercise.
a.zh: 不是。持恒主要为学佛的人设计，但界面用语是中性的，功课可以是任何你想坚持的事：念诵、静坐、读书、锻炼。

q.en: How do I move to a new phone?

a.en: Export a backup on the old phone, copy the file to the new one and restore it there. On Android the backup holds your practices, records, notes and how your library is organized, but not the files themselves, so copy those over too. On iPhone, iPad and HarmonyOS the backup also includes your library files and note images. ChiHeng does not sync through the cloud.
a.zh: 在旧手机上导出备份，把文件拷到新手机上恢复。安卓版的备份里有功课、记录、笔记和资料库的整理方式，但不含资料文件本身，文件要另外拷过去；iPhone、iPad 和鸿蒙版的备份连资料文件和笔记图片一起打包。持恒不做云同步。

a.en: ChiHeng is in testing and not yet in the app stores. This page will link to the stores when it is.
a.zh: 持恒还在测试，暂未在应用商店上架。上架后这里会放下载链接。

t.en: Backups, moving phones, timers and bells
t.zh: 备份、换手机、计时与钟声

t.en: Everything stays on your device
t.zh: 数据都留在你的设备上

t.en: Free to use, provided as is
t.zh: 免费使用，按现状提供

mail.en: Questions or suggestions? Write to {email} with your device model and app version.
mail.zh: 有问题或建议？写信到 {email}，附上设备型号和 App 版本。

description.en: How ChiHeng handles your data: no account, no ads, records stored on your device, backups under your control.
description.zh: 持恒如何处理你的数据：无需账号、没有广告，记录存在本机，备份由你自己保管。

description.en: Terms of Use for the ChiHeng app.
ChiHeng support: backups, moving to a new phone, timers, bells and contacting us.
description.zh: 持恒支持：备份与恢复、换手机、计时与钟声、联系我们。
